provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 100% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 77316-77325 (73% coverage); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 97876 (77%; comparison only, never a publication basis).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos per beatos Apostolos tuos Simonem et Judam ad agnitionem tui
nominis venire tribuisti: da nobis eorum gloriam sempiternam et proficiendo
celebrare, et celebrando proficere. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Perceptis, Domine, sacramentis, suppliciter exoramus: ut, intercedentibus
beatis Apostolis tuis Simone et Juda, quae pro illorum veneranda gerimus
passione, nobis proficiant ad medelam. Per Dominum.
